description: This file defines the OrderContentWrapper class, which implements ContentWrapper to retrieve and cache order-related content for display in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for fetching order content as text, utilizing caching, and rendering content from the database based on order and content type IDs.

classes.name: OrderContentWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements ContentWrapper to manage order content display, caching, and retrieval based on order information, content type, and locale within OFBiz.

methods.name: makeOrderContentWrapper
methods.description: Factory method to create an OrderContentWrapper instance from an order and HTTP request.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns order content as a StringWrapper for a specific content type ID and encoder type.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText
methods.description: Static method to retrieve order content as text, given an order, content type ID, request, and encoder type.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText
methods.description: Static method to retrieve order content as text with specified locale and dispatcher.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText
methods.description: Core static method to retrieve order content as text, with extensive parameters including order, content type, locale, mime type, delegator, dispatcher, and encoding, with caching.

methods.name: getOrderContentAsText (overloaded)
methods.description: Internal method to render order content into a Writer, optionally caching results.
